tools.name: estimate_lane_rate
tools.description: Estimate what it costs to ship one full truckload between two US places: total price, typical low and high, rate per mile, fuel share, road miles and transit days. Returns every truck type unless one is given. Figures are modeled estimates of the all-in price (linehaul plus fuel) for one full truckl

tools.name: get_lane_rate_history
tools.description: Month-by-month estimated price for one lane and one truck type, to show whether today's price is high or low. Figures are modeled estimates of the all-in price (linehaul plus fuel) for one full truckload of standard freight, in US dollars. They are not quotes.

tools.name: get_national_rates
tools.description: This month's US national average truckload rate per mile for every truck type, on a 750-mile haul, with 1, 3 and 12-month changes and the 52-week high and low.

tools.name: get_rate_history
tools.description: Rate per mile for one truck type and its monthly history: national, or for freight leaving or entering one state. Per-mile rates are for a 750-mile haul.

tools.name: get_state_rates
tools.description: Outbound and inbound rate per mile for every lower-48 state and DC, for one truck type, with each state's outbound rate against the national average.

tools.name: list_equipment
tools.description: The truck types Lane Cost prices, with deck size, capacity, pallet count and typical freight. Use it to pick the right truck for a load.

tools.name: get_diesel_price
tools.description: The US average on-highway diesel price per gallon (EIA): the latest week and recent months. It is the fuel input to every estimate.

tools.name: get_fuel_prices
tools.description: This week's average retail price per gallon of diesel, regular, midgrade and premium gasoline for the US and its seven EIA regions, with weekly and yearly changes. From EIA's Monday survey.

tools.name: get_state_fuel_prices
tools.description: This week's price per gallon of diesel and each gasoline grade in every lower-48 state and DC. Each price is marked as an EIA survey or as an estimate from the regional survey and state fuel taxes.

tools.name: get_local_fuel_prices
tools.description: Diesel and gasoline prices per gallon, fuel taxes and monthly price history for one US state, city or ZIP. Only ten cities have their own survey; any other city or ZIP returns its state's average, and each price says which it is. These are area averages, not station prices.

tools.name: get_fuel_cost_per_mile
tools.description: What diesel costs each truck type per mile at this week's price: assumed miles per gallon, fuel per mile, fuel per 1,000 miles and fuel's share of the all-in rate. For the US average, or for one state, city or ZIP.

tools.name: estimate_lane_fuel_cost
tools.description: Estimate the diesel a truck burns between two US places: road miles, gallons, fuel cost, fuel per mile and fuel's share of the lane's all-in estimate. Returns every truck type unless one is given. Diesel is priced at the average of the origin and destination states.

tools.name: search_places
tools.description: Look up US cities by the start of their name, or ZIP codes by their first digits. Use it when a place is not found by the other tools.
